estimand: Under IID independent events uniformly assigned to all 82x41 physical-site/date-pair cells, retained in a synthetic selected-day fraction f and independently balanced between two branches, the EXPECTED NUMBER of site-pairs with >=1 detection on each branch. This is a necessary (not sufficient) support condition for strict per-site-pair conditional exchangeability that fixes both observed branch totals; NOT a power bound for the original pooled conditional-Poisson regression.
assumptions: published full-year events can be hypothetically independently assigned to 41 mirrored 2022 pairs even if actual dates would not match
station and pair assignment uniformly random and detection events independent
branch probability exactly 1/2 within each assigned site-pair
no variation among site-pairs in occurrence, camera functioning, species presence or event deduplication
fraction f a scenario only, never derived from day fraction or real operating window
ancillary_metrics: expected number of site-pairs with >=2 pooled detection events
theoretical combinatorial maximum number of both-branch site pairs floor(N/2) at f=1; not an estimate
strict conditional permutable phase labels also require events in more than one phase bin, not tested here
scientific_guardrails: a one-sided detection is informative under existing common-beta conditional Poisson regression when both branch exposures are positive, even if pair branch totals are not both positive
do not treat this expectation as an observed count or a distribution-free upper bound
does not indicate confidence interval, p-value, test size, future study validity, or causal ecology
full-year count scenarios are optimistic illustrative supplies, not all on original paired dates
actual retained source events and independent device activity are unknown
no source download, real animal detection rows, GPS or archived inference reclassification
reporting: all four taxa and pooled all-year total, all fractions, plus clear rate/exchangeability warning; freeze before output
